_comment: WHY THIS EXISTS: there is no built-in policy that constrains Cognitive
Services / Foundry deployment capacity. The landing-zone template already
constrains the deployment SKU NAME (deployment-skus.policy.json) but not
its SIZE, so an approved GlobalStandard SKU can still be deployed at any
UNITS: sku.capacity on Standard-family deployments is thousands of
WHAT THIS IS NOT: a spend control. Capacity is throughput, not currency -
a deployment run flat out inside this ceiling for a month is still a large
bill. The real-time spend control is the APIM llm-token-limit policy.
ALIAS VERIFIED 2026-09-25 against the live provider:

properties.displayName: Foundry model deployments must not exceed the approved capacity ceiling
properties.description: Denies or audits Microsoft.CognitiveServices deployments whose sku.capacity exceeds the approved ceiling. Capacity is a throughput ceiling, not a cost ceiling; the gateway token limit remains the real-time spend control.

metadata.description: Audit reports without blocking. Deny blocks the deployment.
Maximum permitted sku.capacity. For Standard-family deployments this is thousands of TPM.
